title: Monte Carlo prediction
summary: Estimate $v_\pi(s)$ by averaging the returns observed after visits to $s$ in complete episodes generated by $\pi$. First-visit MC uses only the first visit in each episode, every-visit MC uses them all, and both converge to $v_\pi(s)$ as the number of visits grows.

title: Monte Carlo control with exploring starts
summary: Generalized policy iteration from sample episodes. Each episode starts from a state–action pair chosen so that every pair can occur. The returns are averaged into $Q(s, a)$, and the policy is made greedy in every state the episode visited (Figure 5.4).
